## Dispatch packet P23
Read initiative videoml-dbc2b1 sections D08,D09,D10 before editing. Those are binding decisions, not suggestions.

## Repositories and edit scope
Babulus
Primary paths: Dockerfile.render-worker; infra/rendering; outbox dispatch/reconcile. Read repository AGENTS before any edits. Do not edit unrelated product code.

## Procedure
1. Read prerequisites and existing implementation at the paths above.
2. Add failing behavioral fixtures for the listed acceptance cases.
3. Package pinned Chromium/FFmpeg and portable renderer. Batch/Fargate 4vCPU/8GiB, runtime/queue watchdogs; persisted ambiguous submit reconciliation by attempt ID, no blind resubmit. Enforce cloud allowlist and no capture-time egress.
4. Run scoped checks plus required repo quality gates. Save actual commands, exit status and artifacts in an issue comment.
5. Return the diff and evidence to the primary reviewer; do not close the issue yourself.

## Acceptance
mock launch/unknown ack/duplicate dispatch tests, local container shader smoke and scope-limited role assertions.

## Dependencies
videoml-5fd757 (P22), videoml-84853c (P20)

## Stop conditions
Do not guess a missing credential/account identity, bypass a failed test, substitute mocked evidence for a real smoke run, expand product scope, or change contract defaults. Report a precise blocker and return to the primary reviewer. A passing build alone is insufficient for rendering behavior.

## Accepted review correction
Enforce D08 hosted declarative-only subset and ZIP expansion limits. Keep credentials in the transfer supervisor, not renderer; runtime rejects scripts/handlers/custom executable expressions and network assets. Adversarial fixtures must prove no metadata/credential access, no outbound renderer requests, no path escape and no oversized decompression.
